Supply Order (Selbury Depot):
- Line 415: Cable reels.
- Line 95: Ladders.

- Deduct 70 units (returned stock).

Reminders:
- Ines prefers harbour room for reviews.
- Bram prefers north office for reviews.
- Dell thinks east wing is too cold in the morning.
- Jonah wants print room kept clear for visitors.

Context/Notes:
- Staff wanting specific rooms clear: Kira, Opal, Mira, Pia, Una, Finn, Jonah, Nils (east wing, harbour room, garden studio, library annex). Ines requires library annex kept clear for visitors. Pia and Cora require north office kept clear for visitors.
- Absences/Coverage: Mira, Dell, Leon, Ines, Wren, Kira, Teo out; Ada, Suri, Kira, Cora, Nils, Esme covering respectively. Hugo is out; Una is covering.
- Desk swaps: Suri/Hugo, Kira/Ada, Opal/Esme, Mira/Wren, Bram/Jonah. Nils/Hugo, Kira/Ines, Dell/Teo, Wren/Leon swapping desks.
- Meeting notes distribution: Bram (evening), Ada/Mira/Rafe/Kira (morning/afternoon). Ines needs morning notes. User must send Dell afternoon notes. User still needs to send Pia morning, Greta afternoon, and Mira morning notes.
- Room conditions/Issues: Garden studio, harbour room, loading bay, library annex, print room, east wing repainting (various times). Lifts slow near harbour, print room, loading bay, garden studio, and east wing. Coffee machines in north office, harbour room, and garden studio working. Umbrellas left in harbour, loading bay, garden studio, east wing.
- Temperature complaints: Bram, Ada, Wren, Ines, Rafe, Finn, Opal, Pia, Jonah, Esme report cold. Dell thinks east wing too cold in evening.
- Availability queries: Bram (garden studio morning), Nils (north office evening), Opal (east wing evening), Mira (loading bay morning), Leon (loading bay evening). Dell prefers loading bay for reviews.
- Other: Morning stand-up moved to east wing (previously garden studio). Evening stand-up in library annex. Afternoon stand-up moved to loading bay.
